title: Workflows (/workflows)
description: Template library + DAG visual builder + run management. Full drag-and-drop workflow editor with ReactFlow. Run visualization with live status overlay.
architectureNotes: ReactFlow for DAG builder and run visualization. Node types: job, approval, delay, condition, notify, fan-out. Bidirectional: graph ↔ JSON definition. Runs at /workflows/:id/runs/:runId with Gantt timeline (Recharts). JSON/YAML import as secondary input method.
